mapper.select: UPDATE adi_finetune_job t SET status = 'running', update_time = now(), claim_time = COALESCE(t.claim_time, now()), start_time = now(), heartbeat_time = now(), stop_flag = false, fail_reason = '', worker_id = #{workerId}, worker_epoch = md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text) WHERE t.id = ( SELECT p.id FROM adi_finetune_job p WHERE p.status = 'pending' AND p.is_deleted = false AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING *

UPDATE adi_finetune_job SET heartbeat_time = now(), progress = #{progress}, current_epoch = #{currentEpoch}, train_loss = #{trainLoss}, eval_loss = #{evalLoss} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND worker_epoch = #{workerEpoch} RETURNING stop_flag
mapper.update: UPDATE adi_finetune_job SET status = #{status}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, end_time = now(), update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'running' AND worker_epoch = #{workerEpoch}

UPDATE adi_finetune_job SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 'stopped' ELSE status END, fail_reason = CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 'stopped by admin' ELSE fail_reason END, stop_flag = true, end_time = CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN now() ELSE end_time END, update_time = now() WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND status IN ('pending', 'running') AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE adi_finetune_job SET status = 'pending', update_time = now(), worker_id = '', worker_epoch = '', progress = 0, current_epoch = 0, train_loss = 0, eval_loss = 0 WHERE status = 'running' AND COALESCE(heartbeat_time, start_time, update_time) < now() - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::interval
mapper.select: UPDATE adi_finetune_job t SET status = 'failed', fail_reason = 'max execution time exceeded', end_time = now(), update_time = now(), stop_flag = true WHERE t.status = 'running' AND t.start_time < now() - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::interval RETURNING *
